_readme: Drives kerzie.ai/swingbays/proposal (src/app/swingbays/proposal/route.ts). mode: 'proposal' shows the offer; 'project' puts the dashboard on top and keeps the proposal underneath as 'What you approved'. ?view=project previews project mode without changing this field. Recipe: Wade OS clients/swing_bays/README_project_page.md. Price and scope revised 2026-10-01 after the 3:04 PM Aaron call and Wade's rulings: one up-front price ($27,500, Back Cover included, half at signing and half at the end of the first 30 days), scope shown in build order as two columns, hard date Friday, October 9, 2026. Payment terms revised 2026-10-08 after the 4:14 PM Wade/Aaron call (Dustin debrief): same total, monthly schedule (price.schedule), the October 9 hard date dropped; first payment is due on signing.

prepared.by: Aaron Jones and Wade Kerzie, Kerzie AI Solutions

price._note: Wade 10/8 (Aaron call, Dustin debrief): same total, new schedule. The first four months total back_cover + build + run_months x run_monthly ($35,000) and are paid per `schedule` (month 1 on signing, then months 2, 3 and 4; month 4 is the transfer month). The page checks that the schedule sums to that total. rtu_monthly covers rtu_included_stores active stores and starts after month 4; rtu_per_store_monthly is each store beyond that. No hard date: the first payment is due on signing.

schedule.what: Build. We build everything, in the order above, and Parker goes live.
Operate. We run it with Colter, shoulder to shoulder.
Operate. Colter runs it; we watch, oversee and guide.
Transfer. Colter signs off and it's handed over.

price.new_store_includes: the social connectors, the video library, and teaching that store's lead the OS

value.parker_revenue_source: the FDD's Item 19, fiscal year ending June 30, 2025

contacts._note: Aaron and Jordan are the contacts (Wade 10/1). Titles and emails match kerzie.ai/team and the card pages. Wade is the one secondary line. Never add phone numbers here.

scope._note: Shown in build order, two columns: what we do (left) and what you do (right). dep: true marks a row where our work waits on the right-hand item. Stacks to one column on phones.

items.title: The Back Cover
items.we: The Back Cover pages for every store, first. Everything below runs on top of them.
items.you: Add us as a user on the website. We do the rest.

items.title: The customer record and outreach
items.we: Every customer and member in one record, with where each person came from. Then outreach in waves: first visits, new members, renewals, failed payments, lapsed customers.
items.you: Add us as a user on Square. We do the connecting.

items.title: Club repair
items.we: A Kerzie-hosted repair form, linked or embedded from your website, with a location dropdown. Colter works one queue. The customer gets a text back with the day the clubs are ready. One repair template for every store; custom variations are quoted separately.
items.you: Your list of locations for the dropdown.

items.title: After-hours answering
items.we: Every call and text answered after hours. Phone forwarding only: one local number per store, and your line forwards to it after close. Englewood's number is answered from opening day.
items.you: Forward each store's line to its local number after close. We give Colter the steps.

items.title: Instagram and Facebook DMs answered
items.we: DMs on both answered from the same record, in your voice.
items.you: Add us to the Instagram and Facebook accounts.

items.title: Your command center
items.we: The cockpit on the Swing Bays Mac server, in Claude, and the dashboard at one private web address. Section 1 shows both.
items.you: The Swing Bays Mac server and the Claude plan, bought in Swing Bays' name. We spec both.

items.title: Your voice everywhere
items.we: Scheduled posts for every store, your daily lesson videos cut into shorts, a Swing Bays YouTube channel and TikTok, email on a schedule, and an opt-in text list.
items.you: Your lesson videos as you record them.

items.title: Corporate events found and followed up
items.we: Local companies found, contacted and followed through to a booking, with a corporate events page for each market.

items.title: Booking by text
items.we: Book a bay or a lesson inside a text or DM, and 'is there a bay open tonight at seven?' answered live. Switched on the day SimHouse is connected.
items.you: A session with Keegan on SimHouse.

items.title: November 1 corporate office launch
items.we: Outbound invitations to a list you provide, sent from the same record Englewood will run on.

items.title: New stores and the playbook
items.we: Coming-soon stores live from day one, the opening checklist, the franchise playbook loaded, staff training materials, and the Monday page for Dustin and partners.
items.you: Each new store's opening date and its lead, as you know them.

scope.out_of_scope: Not in this scope: the 24/7 key-code and door security system. We can give Colter guidance on it, nothing more.

nov1.heading: November 1 corporate office launch
nov1.body: Outbound invitations to a list you provide. They go out from the same record Englewood will run on, and Englewood's number is answered from opening day.

timeline._note: Wade 10/1: show we are thinking ahead. Every date here is TENTATIVE and conditional on the signed agreement and the first payment. The October 9 hard date was dropped 10/8 (Wade/Aaron call); nothing date-specific replaces it. Mirrored as milestones in project mode.
timeline.heading: Once you sign
timeline.label: Tentative
timeline.intro: Tentative dates, so you can see the shape of it. They start from the day the signed agreement and the first payment land.

rows.what: A virtual session with Keegan: the SimHouse code walkthrough.
Jordan on site in Parker with Colter. The Swing Bays Mac server is set up, the first training runs, and the November 1 launch invitations are prepped.
Corporate office launch invitations go out to your list.
Jordan back on site with Colter around the day-30 hand-off. Colter starts running it; we watch, oversee and guide.
Colter signs off and it's handed over.

command_center._note: Wade memo 10/1 12:11 PM. Two parts: the cockpit (where work is instructed, in Claude on the Swing Bays Mac server) and the dashboard (one private web address, phone or laptop, updated as things happen). The sample numbers below are placeholders shown as 'Sample' on the page; they are not real.
command_center.cockpit: On the Swing Bays Mac server, in Claude. This is where the work is instructed from: schedule the month's posts, change what the AI says on the phone, add a store, ask for the numbers. Colter, Dustin or Brenna sits here.
command_center.dashboard: One private web address, open it on your phone or laptop. It updates as things happen, so you see how the business is running without asking anyone.
dashboard_shows: The post calendar for every store, a calendar view like the one Kerzie AI runs its own on
Calls the AI answered and handled
DMs received across Instagram and Facebook
Club repairs in the queue and done
New contacts in the customer record

money_view.name: Money view
money_view.what: A read-only connection to QuickBooks or Square, added to the dashboard: money in, money out, revenue and new members.
money_view.who: Visible only to the people Dustin chooses, for example Dustin and Brenna.
money_view.promise: We never move, change, or touch your money. It is a view, nothing more.
money_view.price: Quoted if you want it. Not included in the prices above.
